selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What image is used at the beginning of the passage to explain something hidden from sight?
questions.answer: A huge unusual tree hidden behind a veil is used as the main image.

questions.question: What does the passage say is obvious about the connection between a tree and its members?
questions.answer: Their parts must relate to one another with harmony and balance.

questions.question: Why is it significant that the tree has never been seen?
questions.answer: It makes an accurate drawing of it strong evidence of knowledge beyond normal observation.

questions.question: What kind of relationships would have to appear in the drawing?
questions.answer: The relationships between all the parts, including their sizes, positions, and fitting connections.

questions.question: Why is the accuracy of these drawings so striking?
questions.answer: Because the object being drawn has not been seen openly.

questions.question: What does the tree symbolize when the passage applies the example?
questions.answer: It symbolizes the full reality of creation.

questions.question: What has the Qur'an preserved in its description of creation?
questions.answer: It has preserved the right proportion and fitting relation among all parts of existence.

questions.question: What effect did the Qur'an's descriptions have on careful scholars?
questions.answer: They recognized the beauty and precision of its portrayals and praised Allah.

questions.question: What did researchers conclude when they studied the Qur'an's presentation of this order?
questions.answer: They concluded that it is wonderfully fitting and that the Qur'an uniquely explains reality.

questions.question: What is the main argument of the passage in one sentence?
questions.answer: The Qur'an's descriptions are so comprehensive and balanced that they point to perfect knowledge of the whole of creation.

questions.question: What kind of tree are readers asked to imagine?
questions.answer: A vast and extraordinary tree spread out widely but hidden in the unseen.

questions.question: What qualities must exist among the tree's parts?
questions.answer: Mutual relation, harmony, and balance.

questions.question: Why would a correct sketch on the veil remove doubt?
questions.answer: Because such a sketch would reveal exact knowledge of something no one could see directly.

questions.question: What action does the imagined person perform on top of the veil?
questions.answer: He draws the hidden structure with exact boundaries and proper proportions.

questions.question: What does the phrase about an eye reaching the unseen point to?
questions.answer: It points to penetrating knowledge of what is hidden from ordinary view.

questions.question: How wide is the created order described in the passage?
questions.answer: It stretches from the world's beginning to the far end of the hereafter, from the earth to the divine throne, and from tiny particles to the sun.

questions.question: What ranges are mentioned to show the scope of that order?
questions.answer: From the start of the world to the hereafter, from the earth to the divine throne, and from particles to the sun.

questions.question: How does the passage show the enormous scale of this tree of creation?
questions.answer: It spans time, space, and levels of existence from the smallest things to the greatest.

questions.question: According to the scholars' response, what special role does the Qur'an play?
questions.answer: It serves as the one that unlocks the hidden meaning of the universe and creation.

questions.question: What does their response imply about the Qur'an's insight?
questions.answer: It implies that the Qur'an has a uniquely deep understanding of the structure and meaning of existence.

questions.question: What is concealed at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: A strange and immense tree is concealed behind a veil of the unseen.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the shaping of each part of the tree?
questions.answer: Each part is shaped in line with the tree's own nature.

questions.question: Which examples of parts are listed to make that principle concrete?
questions.answer: Branches, fruit, leaves, and blossoms.

questions.question: What would someone need to do to represent that hidden tree convincingly?
questions.answer: He would need to draw every part accurately and connect distant parts in the right measure.

title: Description of Creation's Reality Through the Tree Parable
